title: Etheric double
html_source: It is tempting to dismiss the content in these parodies as frivolous or as objects of Joyce’s derision, and so one should avoid that temptation as a Joycean trap. There is much, for instance, in the Theosophical concept of the etheric double that is of concern to Joyce. While he and Stephen Dedalus disparage some aspects of Theosophy, some of its ideas (such as universal brotherhood, and metempsychosis – at least metaphorically) become important in Ulysses.
